title: Pile Peek — Card Pile Preview
description:
Hover the draw, discard or exhaust pile to see card names and current resource costs. Hold Alt plus the pile's keyboard shortcut for a quick preview without opening the full card screen.

[h2]Quick pile previews[/h2]
[list]
[*]Compact lists for draw, discard and exhaust piles.
[*]Current energy and star costs, including X costs.
[*]Upgraded cards keep their green names and + suffix.
[*]Hold Alt+A for draw, Alt+S for discard or Alt+X for exhaust with the default game bindings. Release to hide. The mod follows your current native pile shortcuts.
[*]Scroll over a pile button to browse a long list. Ordinary clicks and unmodified shortcuts still open the game's full viewer.
[/list]

[h2]No hidden draw order[/h2]
The draw preview uses the same display sorting as the native pile viewer. It does not reveal the shuffled draw sequence or change cards, costs or gameplay decisions.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
Subscribe to BaseLib and RitsuLib as well as Pile Peek, wait for downloads, then enable the mods in the game's Mod Settings. The SDK is not required.

[h2]Languages[/h2]
English and Russian, following the game language with English fallback. Card names remain game-localized.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Version 0.1.1 was tested locally on Windows with Slay the Spire 2 0.107.1, BaseLib 3.4.7 and RitsuLib 0.6.7. Native standalone combat and client windows from 1280x720 to 1920x1080 were checked. Newer releases and multiplayer have not been verified.

[h2]Bug reports[/h2]
Include game/mod versions, the pile and card involved, your language and window size, and what you expected. A screenshot and relevant log excerpt help.
